regime.label: +978.3 of dealer gamma at the money - the window's first real long-gamma shelf - holds 1,050.4 on the 1,050 pain anchor, but 77 DTE and a -4,943.8 trough below 1,040 make it positioning gravity, not a pin
evidence: +978.3 is net dealer GEX within 20 points of the money, the highest of the 12-session window, up from +442.6 yesterday and a sign flip from -443.9 five sessions ago. Spot 1,050.4 sits 0.4 points above the 1,050 hinge where per-strike net GEX turns positive (+654.3 at 1,050 against -202.1 at 1,040), so dealers now dampen moves at the money instead of amplifying them - the opposite of 2026-10-09, when 1,045.3 traded 4.7 points below that same hinge.

-652.9 is total net GEX across the strip and the cumulative sum still never crosses zero anywhere from 960 to 1,150: it opens at -822.0, bottoms at -4,943.8 on the 1,040 strike and ends negative. There is no gamma flip in the chain. The dampening is a +4,290.8 shelf stacked at and above 1,050 sitting directly on top of a -4,943.8 amplification trough beneath it, so the long-gamma read is only true while spot holds the hinge.

17,534 contracts of total OI (+242 today, +2,197 or +14.3% over five sessions) rules out Unwind, and the build is put-led today: put OI +183 against call +59, lifting put/call volume to 1.22 from 0.48. At 77 DTE with 8,811 put against 8,723 call OI and every wall 6.5 sigma or further away, this is a back quarter still drawing its risk map and bidding insurance - the Protection signature - not a series forming an expiry pin.

6.53 sigma to the 1,100 call wall (1,338 OI, 49.6 points) and 6.63 sigma to the 1,000 near-money put wall (979 OI, 50.4 points) against a 7.6-point daily sigma: no wall is reachable inside a day's move, so none is live structure. The one strike passing Vol2Vol is the 1,020 put - 138 lots, the board's heaviest, on +35 OI at 10.62% IV - which is genuine protection being laid 30.4 points (4.0 sigma) below spot, while the 1,100 call wall added only +11 OI on 74 lots and the 1,791-OI 960 floor traded 32 lots at 11.89 sigma out: both stale.

S50Z26.five_day_thesis: +0.7 points in five sessions (1,049.7 on 2026-10-06 to 1,050.4) inside a 8.9-point range, with max pain parked on 1,050 for all six - the price is doing nothing and the structure underneath it is doing everything. The gamma repair is the signal: net GEX at the money went -443.9 to +978.3 while the shelf at and above 1,050 built +866.1 (3,424.7 to 4,290.8) and the trough below deepened -634.5 (-4,309.3 to -4,943.8), netting a modest -884.6 to -652.9 improvement that still never crosses zero anywhere in the 960-1,150 strip. OI added 2,197 contracts (+14.3%) to 17,534 across the five, so the force is building rather than fading, but it is building on both sides of a hinge rather than into a single wall - 77 DTE is too early for the ATM gamma concentration a pin needs. Positioning rotated through the window: put/call OI fell 1.077 to 1.010 via the first sub-parity 0.996 print on 2026-10-10, and flow flipped from 0.48 to 1.22 put/call volume in a session. ATM IV crept 11.18% to 11.49% and 25-delta skew held flat and call-rich at -0.82 to -0.81, while realized ran 3.7 points a day against the 7.6-point implied sigma - 49% of implied, which is the whole case for selling the range rather than owning it.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1000P / 980P x 1080C / 1100C
strategies.rationale: +978.3 of dealer gamma at the money means dealer re-hedging fades moves rather than chasing them, and realized volatility has run at 49% of the 7.6-point implied sigma for five sessions, so the structure sells a range the hedging flow is already defending; both shorts sit on the 25-delta bands (1,000 put, 1,080 call) with the 1,000 near-money put wall and the 1,100 call wall as the wings, which is the long-gamma plus compressed-IV cell of the direction x volatility matrix.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width less 6.2 net credit = 13.8 points per side (put side 1,000 bid 8.4 against 980 ask 6.1 = 2.3; call side 1,080 bid 9.7 against 1,100 ask 5.8 = 3.9). Breakevens 993.8 and 1,086.2, which are 7.45 and 4.71 daily sigma from spot. Short vol is negative-skew - the capped loss is real and argues for small size.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1,040 drops spot off the hinge into the -4,943.8 trough where dealers amplify weakness, which breaks the short-vol premise well before the 993.8 breakeven; on the upside the 1,080 short leg is today's 25-delta band, so that band stepping up with IV expanding invalidates the call side.

strategies.rationale: 1,050 has been max pain for six sessions and spot sits 0.4 points above it on a +654.3 long-gamma strike, so a credit vertical below spot leans toward the pin from underneath - and the 1,020 short leg is the one strike on the board that passes Vol2Vol today (138 lots, +35 OI), meaning it sells into genuine protection demand rather than stale OI, though that same live bid is the reason to treat it as a narrower expression than the condor.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width less 3.5 net credit = 16.5 points (1,020 put bid 12.0 against 1,000 put ask 8.5). Breakeven 1,016.5, which is 33.9 points or 4.46 daily sigma below spot.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1,040 with volume and IV expanding together - the trough beneath the hinge is -4,943.8 and would carry price through the short strike faster than the implied sigma; fresh put OI building at 1,030-1,040 on rising IV would mean the protection bid has moved inside the spread.

strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 10.1 points (1,040 put ask 18.5 less 1,000 put bid 8.4); the 40-point width caps max gain near 29.9 points, breakeven 1,029.9, which is 20.5 points or 2.70 daily sigma below spot.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained close above 1,060 puts spot inside the +4,290.8 dampening shelf with the 1,040 strike well below it and the structure becomes pure decay at 77 DTE; a flat tape that holds 1,045-1,055 bleeds it just as effectively.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,040-1,050 is the hinge that decides the regime: above it spot sits on a +4,290.8 long-gamma shelf with max pain at 1,050 and dealers fading moves, below 1,040 it falls into a -4,943.8 trough with no cumulative gamma flip anywhere from 960 to 1,150. The base case is continued compression inside roughly 1,045-1,055 - realized has run 3.7 points a day against a 7.6-point implied sigma for five sessions, the pain bowl is shallow but centred (720,640 at 1,050 against 730,500 at 1,040 and 727,590 at 1,060), and the +978.3 of ATM gamma is the first genuine dampening the window has produced. A close below 1,040 on expanding volume and IV is the invalidation and would be the max-pain failure pattern rather than something to fade, with 1,020 (-915.0 net GEX, and today's live 138-lot put build) the first reference beneath; a close above 1,060 instead grinds toward the 1,100 wall, which added only +11 OI on 74 lots today and is stale structure rather than live resistance.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position size is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical share delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning and max-pain magnetism are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1,050 anchor as a tendency, not a guarantee. At 77 DTE the pin mechanism (ATM gamma rising as time to expiry collapses) is barely active, the +978.3 ATM shelf is thin against 17,534 contracts of total OI, and the pain bowl is only 1.4% deep across 1,040-1,060 - all three argue for low confidence in mean reversion, which is why this is classified Protection rather than Pinning. The absence of any cumulative gamma flip in the 960-1,150 strip means the long-gamma read is conditional on spot holding 1,040-1,050 and nothing more. OI is a burden map, not a direction: the 1.01 put/call OI ratio, the 1,791-OI 960 floor at 11.89 sigma and the 1,338-OI 1,100 call wall at 6.53 sigma show where risk is parked, not which way price must go, and the deep-OTM call IVs printing near 9.5% below 1,010 are stale quotes on zero volume rather than tradable vol. Macro or news flow can override the option structure outright, and defined-risk structures cap the loss but that capped loss is real - short-vol payoffs are negative-skew, small frequent gains against rare large losses.
